title: SOC2 evidence + vendor review scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for SOC2 evidence collection + vendor review.

Goal: get a clean evidence bundle for readiness review by 2026-03-10. Focus items: access control exports, vendor SOC reports, config screenshots, retention policies, incident log exports.

Top-level TODOs (prio order):
- [ ] Export Okta group membership CSV (all admin groups) — needed for user access evidence (SEC-142). Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-02-15 (missed) -> follow up with Jonah for help extracting via API.
- [ ] Pull GCP logging retention config + logs export sample for last 90 days (audit log). Note: may need elevated perms. Ticket SEC-203.
- [ ] Vendor review: collect latest SOC2+ISO reports from key vendors: Sentry, Datadog, PostHog? (confirm list). Request email template below.
- [ ] Update SSAE mapping sheet (Confluence index) with file paths and who uploaded.
- [ ] Create screenshot deck for console configs (IAM roles, bucket ACLs) — aim for 20 slides.

Vendor review quick checklist (for each vendor):
- Contact: legal/vendor-management PR template? (see linked confluence).
- Do we have: latest SOC2 report (date), subprocessor list, DPA signed, encryption at rest details, incident history last 12 months.
- Red flags: no SOC2, no subprocessor list, uses shared tenants for customer data.

Recent notes / convo fragments: 
- Meeting 2026-02-20 with Jonah: asked him to run Okta API export script. He said will do on Monday 2/23. Need result by 2/26.
- Eve suggested we prioritize Datadog as evidence is missing for log retention. She will coordinate with infra.
- Reminder: include proof of backup config for DBs (daily snapshots + test restore notes) — ask DB team for restore logs.

Evidence matrix (quick, incomplete):
- Access control: Okta export (WIP), admin access change log (need audit export)
- Logging & monitoring: GCP audit logs (missing sample), Datadog retention policy (in progress)
- Change management: PR approvals for infra changes (link PRs) -> need list from GitHub (use /insights query)
- Backups: DB snapshot schedule + restore test report (ask DB eng)
- Incident response: incident runbook (latest), postmortem examples (last 12 months)

Email template to vendors (draft):
> Hi [Vendor],
> We are performing a SOC2 readiness review and would appreciate if you could share your most recent SOC2/ISO report, current subprocessor list, and the date of last penetration test. If the report is under NDA, please point us to the package or a contact who can arrange access.
> Thanks,
> Priya (Redwood Inference)

Open questions / blockers:
- Does legal have the standard NDA process for getting vendor SOC2 reports? Pinged legal on 2026-02-25 (no reply).
- Are PostHog events processed with PII in any pipelines? Need confirmation from analytics.
- How to show encryption at rest for self-managed Redis? Ticket to infra?

Quick commands / snippets to run (notes to self):
- Okta API: /api/v1/groups?filter=type+eq+"OKTA_GROUP" -> export members via pagination (Jonah to handle)
- GCP logs: gcloud logging buckets list && gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:Write" --limit=1000 --project=redwood-prod

Meeting prep for 2026-03-02 readiness sync:
- Bring: current evidence matrix, list of missing items, timeline to readiness, vendor status.
- Ask: Legal for NDA flow, Infra for log samples, DB for restore logs.

Notes to self: keep this as working doc until evidence upload completes. Convert to formal evidence index when >80% items have artifacts.

Misc short reminders:
- Add tags on Confluence page after upload.
- Create a folder in shared_drives/security-and-compliance/evidence/ with subfolders by control (ask infra for write access).
- Follow-up slack thread: slack:#sec-compliance pinned messages -> attach this doc.

End of scratchpad.
